blocks.text: (used with verbs) arrival — при- + -йти́ (“to go”) → прийти́ (“to come”); при- + лете́ть (“to fly”) → прилете́ть (“to arrive by plane”)
при- — indicating action or motion towards a terminal point
Wiktionary's etymology of приходи́ть glosses its при- as “indicating action or motion towards a terminal point”.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to come (to), to arrive (at) (place, conclusion, state of abandonment, anger, insanity)

blocks.text: у- — moving away from, leaving a place by the action of the base verb

«выражает удаление, покидание какого-либо места с помощью действия, названного мотивирующим глаголом» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of у-. Its examples: увезти, угнать, уйти, укатиться, улететь.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to take away, to carry away (by vehicle); to abduct, to kidnap
to steal anything that can move by itself (vehicle, vessel, cattle, etc)
to leave, to depart, to go (away) (by foot); to escape, to evade
to fly away, to depart (by flying); (figuratively) to be carried away or transported in thoughts or feelings

blocks.text: away — у- + -йти́ (“to go”) → уйти́ (“to go away, to leave”); у- + е́хать (“to go (by horse or vehicle)”) → уе́хать (“to depart (by conveyance)”)
